Help & Clarity

Frequently Asked Questions

Temukan jawaban seputar layanan private transfer Bali, tiket fast boat Sanur, dan transportasi Nusa Penida.

Can I book a transfer last minute?
Yes! We accommodate same-day and last-minute requests depending on driver and boat availability. Simply message our WhatsApp support for real-time dispatch.
Do you provide hotel pickup and drop-off?
Absolutely. We offer door-to-door private transfers from all popular areas including Kuta, Seminyak, Canggu, Ubud, Jimbaran, and Nusa Dua directly to Sanur Port or around Nusa Penida.
Can I book a private vehicle for the entire day?
Yes, our Nusa Penida and Bali Day Tours include a private air-conditioned vehicle, professional local driver, and petrol for 8-10 hours.
How do I pay for my transfer?
We accept cash on arrival (IDR), Indonesian bank transfers (BCA/Mandiri), and QRIS. No credit card pre-authorization hassle required.
Can I change or reschedule my booking?
Free rescheduling is available up to 12 hours prior to your scheduled pickup time. Just inform our team via WhatsApp.

Masih punya pertanyaan lain seputar perjalanan Anda?
